'''2003 DPC Chicago Justin Desai DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2003 DPC Chicago]], finishing 1st; the list below is from the official Players Committee decklist form.<ref name="src">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Decks/dpcchicago/desaiDS.pdf SWCCG Players Committee decklist form: KtoD Senate]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030607073211/http://swccgpc.com:80/Decks/dpcchicago/desaiDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Desai]]
* '''Event:''' [[2003 DPC Chicago]]
* '''Finish:''' 1st
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' KtoD Senate
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]]
* '''Source:''' [http://www.swccgpc.com/Decks/dpcchicago/desaiDS.pdf PC decklist form] (preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030607073211/http://swccgpc.com:80/Decks/dpcchicago/desaiDS.pdf Internet Archive])
